info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_System Deployment Management API
info.description: The System Deployment Management API provides functionalities to oversee and retrieve information related to the deployment processes of the MICROSERVICE_PROD banking system. This API enables IT managers and system administrators to access deployment details, including status checks and configuration data, to ensure smooth operational continuity. Typical use cases include monitoring deployment progress, troubleshooting deployment issues, and maintaining system integrity. It serves as a vital tool for enhancing system management efficiency within the banking IT infrastructure.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details of a specific system deployment identified by its unique resource ID. It provides comprehensive information about the deployment, including its current status, associated resources, and configuration settings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to obtain detailed information related to the system deployment with the identifier RES-100045. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the specified schema for successful processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested resource details.

GetSystemDeploymentByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to system deployment in IT management. The body is expected to be a string.

GetSystemDeploymentByIdResponse_200.title: System Deployment Response

systemId.description: The unique identifier for the system.

environment.description: The deployment environment of the system (e.g., production, staging).

changeId.description: The unique identifier for the change associated with this deployment.

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for the system.

plannedAt.description: The planned date and time for the deployment.

serviceTier.description: The service tier associated with the deployment.

availabilityTargetPercent.description: The target availability percentage for the system.

maintenanceWindow.description: The scheduled maintenance window for the system.

recordStatus.description: The status of the deployment record.

version.description: The version number of the deployment.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update to the deployment record.

GetSystemDeploymentByIdResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response for the system deployment operation including various attributes related to the deployment.

DeploymentMetadata.title: Deployment Metadata

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier used to track the request and response.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

DeploymentMetadata.description: This schema represents the metadata related to a deployment including IDs and timestamps.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme that uses bearer tokens. This scheme requires a JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header for secure access to the API.
